apply: ADDITIVE · NOT APPLIED · Georg approved the jumps (2026-10-08) and the stand-up rev c (2026-10-09, "top! kann eingecheckt werden")
space: glTF, Y up, actor faces +Z, actor root at the origin; all positions in KayKit units (kit factor 1, multiply by the world FIG_SCALE)
skeleton: identical to KFB_Motion_forge01.glb / KFB_Motion_forge01_table.glb (24 nodes, no meshes, no skins)
build: pose dump from Blender -> scripts/kfb_pose_dump_to_glb.py (no glTF export in live Blender); round trip vs the authored poses: max 0.0003 cm (Medium), 0.05 cm (Large)
channels: translation + rotation + scale on every bone; Rig_Medium seat clips also move upperleg.l/.r (KayKit Sit_Chair_* joint offsets)

credits: KayKit (Kay Lousberg) · CC0 · rigs, Sit_Chair_Down/StandUp, Jump_Start/Idle/Land, Dungeon stool + table_medium, Mystery Monthly Clown circus_podium

clips.rootMotion: baked into the hips; the root stays at the seated working spot (same as kfb_activity_table_*_b)
clips.next: kfb_activity_table_eat_b (frame 0 = the activity's first frame; any table activity works, the arms blend to its frame 0)
clips.sequence: KayKit Sit_Chair_Down (unmodified lower body; Rig_Large = Medium retargeted) at scoot distance behind the working spot -> arms blend 14 frames -> scoot in 12 frames with the stool

stool.rule: keyed by the runtime: stool offset along the actor axis, glTF -Z = away from the table, KayKit units of the rig; the stool stands back until seat contact, then slides in with the actor

clips.label_de: Vom Tisch aufstehen, Beine schieben den Hocker zurück
clips.rootMotion: baked into the hips; ends standing at the scoot distance behind the working spot (glTF -Z), one foot planted from touchdown
clips.prev: any kfb_activity_table_*_b (frame 0 of the clip = the activity's frame 0)
clips.sequence: 6-frame lead-in to KayKit Sit_Chair_StandUp; no back travel while seated; back travel only once the hips leave the seat (first just enough to keep belly and knees out of the table slab, the rest during the hop-off); hands lifted over table and food by a hand path (IK) and dropped behind the edge; head tilted back up to 12° (Farmer) to clear the food; KayKit step of one foot kept, the other planted; 10-frame standing hold

stool.rule: pushed by body vertices below the seat top (back of the thighs during the hop-off), then coasts with friction (velocity x0.70 per frame); the runtime keys it along the actor axis, glTF -Z = away from the table

clips.supersedes: kfb_seat_stand_up_table_b (scoot back seated first; Georg 2026-10-08: no push-off from the table)

prop.placement: up: prop centre ahead of the actor so the clip ends on the top centre; down: the actor starts on the top centre and lands depth/2 + 0.75 x scale in front
